nodes.question: How can emerging technologies improve accessibility to job and social opportunities, as discussed by Batty et al. (2012)?
nodes.answer: Batty et al. (2012) highlight the need for emerging technologies to improve accessibility to job and social opportunities by leveraging tools such as AI and blockchain to identify inequality in resource distribution and monitor changes over time.
